sentences.text: The evidence does not show a 5% pre-payment charge or foreclosure fee for a gold loan.

For cases outside the listed exceptions, the UCB rule says any pre-payment charge, if levied, shall be as per the approved policy of the UCB, and no approved gold-loan policy or gold-loan fee sheet is provided here.

missing.searched: Searched the provided in-force evidence and rule findings for a gold-loan-specific pre-payment charge or foreclosure fee; none was provided.
Searched for the bank’s approved policy for gold loans on pre-payment/foreclosure charges; none was provided.
